name: Dual Contouring Leaf Processing
definition: Processes a leaf voxel of size 1 to generate a single vertex and normal for the implicit surface by finding edge intersections, estimating normals, and minimizing a quadratic error function.
summary: Dual Contouring Leaf Processing generates a mesh vertex and normal for a unit leaf voxel using edge intersections and QEF minimization, differing from siblings by operating strictly on size-1 voxels.
